title: Voice Commands
description: Voice Command brings true voice control to Minecraft. Execute commands with your voice — all fully offline, private, and fast.
body:
🎤 Voice Command – Control Minecraft with your Voice

Voice Command adds local voice control to Minecraft.
You can create custom voice triggers that automatically execute Minecraft commands — with no cloud, no accounts, and no internet connection required.

Speech recognition runs completely offline on your PC.

✨ Features
🗣️ Local Offline Speech Recognition
Powered by the Vosk Speech Recognition Engine
Works completely offline
No data is uploaded
Very low latency

🧠 Hands-Free Gameplay
Needs this mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/controlcommands
Perfect for:

Immersion & roleplay
Accessibility
Streamers & content creators
Comfort & quality-of-life

Play Minecraft without touching your keyboard while building, fighting, or exploring.

Supported languages:

🇬🇧 English
🇩🇪 German
⚙️ Create Custom Voice Commands

Create your own voice triggers, for example:

Spoken phrase	Executes command
“Teleport home”	/tp home
“Give me food”	/give @p bread
“Make it daytime”	/time set day

You can connect any Minecraft command to a voice trigger.

Perfect for:

Immersion & roleplay
Accessibility
Streamers & content creators
Comfort & quality-of-life

🖥️ In-Game Menu & Overlay

The mod includes a built-in interface:

Voice command manager
Status overlay
Keybind to open the menu
🌐 Multiplayer Support
Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
🔒 Privacy First

This mod is 100% offline:

No internet connection required
No telemetry
No cloud services

Your voice stays on your computer.

📦 Requirements
Minecraft (show versions)
Fabric Loader ≥ 0.18.1
Fabric API
Java 21+

WARNING: the mod is may forbidden on a few servers. be carefull with it. And its only execute commands. it cannot let you walk or hit or something. maybe it comes in a update.

You can report bugs on my Discord server
Discord: https://discord.gg/th6fGzE2f
